expiryReady.subtitle: Identify expiry risk, control blocked stock and trace every action.
expiryReady.refreshHint: Refreshes when this screen opens, every minute while active, on resume and on request. The timestamp shows the last successful refresh.
expiryReady.activePolicy: Warning thresholds in days: {{days}}. Today is still eligible; a batch is expired after its expiry date.
expiryReady.thresholdHint: Enter 1–10 positive whole-day thresholds separated by commas. Boundaries are inclusive.
expiryReady.policySaved: Thresholds saved. Current results use the saved policy.
expiryReady.invalidThresholds: Enter 1–10 positive whole numbers separated by commas. No empty or invalid values.
expiryReady.noMatches: No stocked batches match. Use batch search below to inspect other batches or history.
expiryReady.sellable: Eligible for normal sale · FEFO applies
expiryReady.blocked: Blocked or unavailable for normal sale
expiryReady.fefoHint: Only active, unexpired stock with available quantity is eligible for sale. FEFO selects the earliest expiry among eligible batches. Quarantine and recall do not remove physical stock.
expiryReady.branchBound: Actions apply only to the batch and branch shown. Saved requests stay in their original branch.
expiryReady.selectBatch: Select a batch from the worklist or search by product/lot.
expiryReady.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for this action.
expiryReady.wholeBatchHint: The backend removes the full on-hand quantity it reads during the disposal transaction. Partial disposal is unavailable. Concurrent stock activity can change the final balance; verify the accepted quantity and refreshed stock. Reserved stock must be resolved first.
expiryReady.invalidQuantity: Enter a positive quantity with up to four decimal places, using a dot or comma.
expiryReady.insufficient: Quantity exceeds unreserved stock. Refresh the batch and enter an eligible quantity.
expiryReady.supplierUnavailable: Supplier provenance could not be loaded. Retry or inspect the receipt.
expiryReady.noSupplier: No linked supplier receipt is visible for this batch.
expiryReady.returnHint: This is a supplier stock return, separate from disposal. Suppliers shown come from visible purchase receipts. The existing return records the stock removal; put the supplier and return authorization in the note/reference. It does not create a refund or supplier credit.
expiryReady.ineligible: This batch is not eligible for that action. Refresh and check its expiry, status and reserved stock.
expiryReady.balanceUnavailable: Current stock is unavailable. Refresh before acting.
expiryReady.stockChanged: Stock changed since review. Review the refreshed whole-batch quantity before starting a new disposal.
expiryReady.rejected: Action rejected. No change was accepted for this request.
expiryReady.uncertain: The result is not confirmed. The saved request is retained.
expiryReady.retryHint: Retry recovers an accepted result first and keeps the same payload and operation reference.
expiryReady.statusUncertain: Status actions have no server retry key. Check for the saved action; an uncertain action is never automatically repeated. If no result is found, keep this request for reconciliation.
expiryReady.detailRetry: Accepted reference retained. Refresh the result to load current stock and history.
expiryReady.findLocations: Find this product and lot across branches
expiryReady.scopeHint: Only locations visible to your access are shown. Recall is confirmed separately for each batch in its own branch.
expiryReady.openLocation: Open this batch in its branch
expiryReady.switchHint: Unsent fields reset. Saved requests remain in their original branch and return when you switch back.
expiryReady.branchChanged: This action belongs to another branch. Return to its original branch.
expiryReady.alertHint: Shows the current warning level under the saved thresholds. Older stored warning levels remain historical; refresh does not duplicate them.
expiryReady.historyOnline: History shown may be stale. Reconnect to load details.
expiryReady.noMovement: No quantity movement: this action changes eligibility only. The action reference is its history record.
expiryReady.movementUnavailable: Movement details are unavailable. Refresh history; do not post another removal.
expiryReady.currentSnapshot: Stock and status above are current observations; action quantity and timestamp are historical.
expiryReady.preparedHint: This request was saved before sending. Continue with the same reference; current eligibility is checked again.
